verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-search API that handles user queries, images and user identifiers, so a training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training on customer data, an opt-out, or any data-retention or usage policy. The docs cover search, catalog, MCP, CLI, pricing and webhooks only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
